integrity_notes: The proof is self-contained modulo standard binomial limit theorems, strict log concavity, and elementary convex-polytope facts. Finite checks supplement but do not establish infinite claims. Priority comparisons are bounded and independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent common retention probabilities on vertices of the regular cross-polytope only; conditional full-dimensional log-volume limits; no general centrally symmetric or continuous sampling claim.
title: Exact joint face–volume law and annealed–typical gap for Bernoulli-thinned cross-polytopes
